dialogue.text: [warm, slower] From now on, when Jess is short, her card simply gets declined. Checks and automatic bills can still overdraw her, but the gas-pump trap from last night is gone. The next morning at 7:52, her coffee at the same gas station gets declined, and she pays in coins without a cent in fees.
[warm, slower] At nine, a nervous college kid slides his phone across her counter. He's forty dollars in the red.
[warm, slower] What's the worst fee your bank has ever charged you? Put the number in the comments.
